rawFindings.title: Incorrect condition logic in process_params leading to incorrect skipping of param callbacks on 'route' error
rawFindings.explanation: The original code correctly excludes only a specific 'route' error string to prevent skipping param callbacks when the error is 'route'. However, the changed condition `if (paramCalled && (paramCalled.error || paramCalled.match === paramVal))` will skip param callbacks even if the error is 'route', which is incorrect behavior. This could cause middleware relying on 'next("route")' to be bypassed improperly in app.param callbacks.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original condition to only exclude 'route' error string: `if (paramCalled && (paramCalled.match === paramVal || (paramCalled.error && paramCalled.error !== 'route'))) {` to prevent incorrect skipping.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: When an app.param callback calls `next('route')`, the subsequent param callbacks are skipped incorrectly, which breaks expected route skipping behavior.
